svg.aria-label: The same loop three ways. Module level uses STORE_NAME and LOAD_NAME and takes 48.3 ms; a function with global declarations uses STORE_GLOBAL and LOAD_GLOBAL and takes 43.8 ms; a function with locals uses STORE_FAST and LOAD_FAST and takes 25.0 ms. Instruction counts are 17, 16 and 16.
svg.title: The same loop three ways. Module level uses STORE_NAME and LOAD_NAME and takes 48.3 ms; a function with global declarations uses STORE_GLOBAL and LOAD_GLOBAL and takes 43.8 ms; a function with locals uses STORE_FAST and LOAD_FAST and takes 25.0 ms. Instruction counts are 17, 16 and 16.

text.tspan: Same arithmetic, different instructions: s += i, 1,000,000 times
loop body, run 1,000,000 times (STORE_* of i is first: FOR_ITER pushes the next value)
Best of 9 runs, CPython 3.12.13, one Apple M5 laptop. Absolute times vary; the order is the result.
